name: Kokoda
reason: Station town at the track's northern end with the airfield, a museum and the memorial gateway, named by Wikivoyage and the tourism site; a finish line and place to stop.

name: Kokoda Track
reason: Headline 96 km trek named by Wikivoyage, the national tourism site and the country guide; the region's main draw.

name: Popondetta
reason: Provincial capital and regional hub with markets, the airport and the road to Kokoda; a sizable settlement people pass through, named by the tourism site and the country guide (the site says it is a base, so low rank).

name: Tufi
reason: Wikivoyage page, tourism site and country guide all name it: fjords, diving and tapa; a base with a resort and airstrip.
